chapter: Freelancing, Miller and the girls' bands
title: Ina Ray Hutton's band in a battle of the bands with Dick Jurgens
summary: At Madison Square Garden the girls copied Basie's One O'Clock Jump as a gag, and in Chicago Durham made a double band with Dick Jurgens' players.

bands.name: Ina Ray Hutton and Her Orchestra

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well, what sort of a book did they play? I mean, was it --
I'll tell you just what they played. Now, they had a -- in Madison Square Garden, they had a big thing with all the bands, big bands, all of them, Basie, too.

And I said, give me a spot right in front of Basie. I'd fit the spots in, and they'd say, yeah, the girls get what they want. I had One O'Clock Jump written, note for note, and one of the girls, they had her solo down just like Basie was playing, that's what they did. And that made the novelty good, because when they come on and hear Basie, that just knocked the guys out to play just exactly what Basie was playing.
It was a gag, you know? And there was a band out in Chicago they called Dick Jergen. That was --
Oh, Dick Jergen, yeah, I've heard of him.

Aragon Ballroom, big band. So they wanted to have a battle of the bands with Ina's band when it come through. And I went through and I said, I'll fix it. So I wrote Ina's two or three arrangements and I said, give me one of yours, and I took Ina's arrangements and I made another part of each part. Said, now I want the reed section to set like this, a boy and a girl, a boy and a girl, big stage. I said, the boys can sit a little behind.

I said, now, the two drums we can't use, but we'll use -- let's use Dick Jurgens's drummer with the bass, and the girl -- no, wait, I let the girl play the bass drum and I let him play without the bass. And that's what they called a double band, and they hadn't had that before, see, Stanley. So you know they had a good band when I took one of his girls because they read what they see. They could read what they see, and I knew the arrangements.
